minimumEntry: Link existing service consoles through their existing authentication; source-timed manual metadata snapshots allowed; no new Admin API/CRM/Billing
authorityBoundary: Trip Owner/Organizer/QA Account does not imply system operations admin
Existing Data Health is current-account local-data health, not cross-account server operations authority
Do not reuse Mission Control engineering acceptance as live service control or operational health

existingSources.scope: One sanitized last-failure snapshot; method/masked route/kind/status/code/requestId/time/stage where present, no request/response body or tokens; not a trend/time-series/billing source
Account/generation-scoped local findings; must not be relabeled global service metrics
Actual DEV container/image/config/health metadata only as of independent source timestamp; not capacity/uptime SLA

allowedData: Aggregate service health/error/cost/capacity only from qualified owning reader
Sanitized correlation IDs with exact source/time
Actual renewal/quota only from authorized current source
prohibited: Raw user/Trip/expense/document bodies or queue payloads
Public cross-account logs or new operator authority inferred from email/name/Trip role
Privileged shell/SQL/role actions from this local entry
missingRuntimePorts: Approved restricted operator access binding or existing-console-only selection
Qualified service metrics/alerts Reader with privacy filtering
